description: Fetch a PhaseFolio scenario's complete inputs (stage costs, durations, PoS, commercial assumptions, IRA settings) and computed outputs (eNPV, rNPV, cumulative PoS, per-stage breakdown, top sensitivity drivers). This is the authoritative engine output — every signed export ties back to this payload.

scenario_id.description: UUID of the scenario. Get from list_scenarios or the scenario URL in the dashboard.

name: get_scenario

outputSchema.description: Canonical PhaseFolio envelope. Substantive payload is in `data`.

id.description: Scenario UUID. Pass to get_scenario, get_evidence, or get_dossier.

inputs.description: Full scenario inputs blob (stages, costs, durations, PoS, commercial assumptions, IRA settings). Schema mirrors the wizard input model.

is_base.description: True if this is the base case scenario for the project.

label.description: Human-friendly scenario name, e.g. 'Base Case' or 'Bear Case'.

mfp_discount.description: IRA Maximum Fair Price discount magnitude (0–1) used in this scenario, if applicable.

result.description: Full engine output blob: eNPV (USD M), rNPV (USD M), cumulative_pos, per_stage_breakdown[], top sensitivity drivers, optional Monte Carlo percentiles.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last scenario edit.
